target.title: fix(codex): require weekly reset boundary before confetti (#2054)
target.body:
## Summary

- Require Codex weekly limit celebrations to advance `resetsAt`, matching the existing session transient-zero guard from #1986.
- Preserve above-threshold baselines across guarded crossings even when the previous weekly boundary is missing.
- Isolate weekly reset detector ownership with provider-account keys, stable `workspaceAccountID` / auth fingerprints, and propagated `CodexVisibleAccount` context (not plan `loginMethod`).
- Add focused regression coverage plus a redacted live-fetch replay harness.

## Review feedback addressed

- **Baseline when boundary first appears:** guarded crossings now preserve `wasAboveThreshold` even when `previousState.resetBoundary == nil`, so a later genuine boundary advance can still celebrate once.
- **Stable workspace identity:** fallback detector keys now prefer `workspaceAccountID` / auth fingerprint / workspace label from `CodexVisibleAccount`; `plus`/`pro` plan values in `loginMethod` are ignored for ownership.
- **Live proof in default suite:** `issue 2054 live behavior proof from fixture` is disabled unless `CODEXBAR_VERIFY_2054_LIVE_FIXTURE` is set.
- **Packaged-app proof path:** `./Scripts/verify_2054_live.sh` packages this branch by default (`CODEXBAR_SKIP_PACKAGE=0`) and records redacted live CLI output.

## Test plan

- [x] `swift test --filter UsageStorePlanUtilizationIssue2054ReproTests`
- [x] `swift test --filter UsageStorePlanUtilizationCelebrationTests`
- [x] `swift test --filter UsageStorePlanUtilizationCodexOwnershipTests`
- [x] `make check`
- [x] `./Scripts/verify_2054_live.sh`

## Verification

Redacted live behavior proof: [`docs/verify-2054-proof.md`](docs/verify-2054-proof.md)

```text
[verify-2054-proof] PROOF_SUPPRESSED_TRANSIENT_ZERO events=0 weeklyResetsAt=2026-07-18T07:56:55Z
[verify-2054-proof] PROOF_SUPPRESSED_NIL_BOUNDARY events=0
[verify-2054-proof] PROOF_CELEBRATED_REAL_RESET events=1 previousWeeklyResetsAt=2026-07-18T07:56:55Z advancedWeeklyResetsAt=2026-07-25T07:56:55Z
```

New regressions cover:
- boundary first appears → later real reset celebrates once
- same email + same plan + different `workspaceAccountID` stay isolated
- plan change does not churn detector key for the same workspace

Closes #2054
